kanzAlMahalliRecord.statement: The mother receives one sixth when two siblings, male or female, are present.

khulasaRecord.statement: The mother is reduced from one third to one sixth by a counted plurality of brothers and/or sisters.

sourceAgreement.detail: Read together, the sources establish a threshold of two or more siblings, including any male/female combination.

conditions: At least two source-counted siblings are present.
exclusions: One sibling does not trigger this branch.
The descendant branch remains a separate atom.
unresolvedQuestions: The existing project records do not expressly resolve which siblings still count when another admitted rule totally blocks them from inheriting.
admissionBlocker: Blocked-sibling counting is an execution interaction and remains source-incomplete in the available structured records.
